$comment: Machine-readable copy of the relay contract (normative text: relay/PROTOCOL.md). Both relays are held to it by relay/conformance/suite.ts; Mac and iOS tests may read it. Numbers shared with the Mac and the phone (limits, close codes, token grammar) live in companion-wire.json and are not repeated here.

refusals.when: malformed body or params, bad key length, more than 32 devices, body over its cap, not a WebSocket upgrade on /v1/connect
missing or malformed token, bad signature, wrong aud/htm/htu, unknown or bad claims, replayed jti, wrong role; on registration: bad or expired challenge, bad proof-of-possession
a device token that verifies against the device's tombstone key
no registration for this machine id
no live row and no tombstone for the device, daemon connected
a per-address or per-machine+address rate limit
4 phone/pair sockets already open for the machine
the token's principal (the daemon, one device, one pair session) has spent its replay budget
a phone connects (or an unknown device asks) while no daemon is connected

relayWideRefusals.when: the relay is misconfigured (no public host or challenge secret) or shedding load (reference: room cap, circuit breaker)

deviceConnectOrder: live device row, else tombstone; neither: no daemon ? 503 daemon_unavailable : 404 device_unknown
verify the signature against that key (401 token_invalid)
after the signature await, re-read: same key and same live/tombstone state (401 token_invalid)
claims, checked without writing anything (401 token_*)
tombstone? 403 device_revoked (before the jti is consumed: a revoked device never writes to the replay cache)
consume jti from its principal's own budget, synchronously in the same turn (401 token_invalid if replayed, 429 replay_cache_full)
slot reservation, synchronous: older sockets of the same device closed 4409; otherwise 4 sockets per machine (429 too_many_peers)
